search_policy.node_limit: positive integer; root consumes one; checked before visiting a committed successor
search_policy.max_plans: positive integer; truncates ranked output only after search ends

node_accounting.explored_node_count: Concrete planner states with objective and expansion status evaluated, including the root and blocked decision states.
node_accounting.committed_edge_count: Successful commits encountered, including the one whose successor cannot be visited when node_limit is reached.
node_accounting.rejected_edge_count: Action attempts rejected without a successor state; these are never explored nodes.
node_accounting.blocked_node_count: Explored states whose complete legal-action view is blocked.
node_accounting.repeated_state_count: Visited states whose full semantic-hash key matches a prior visit and whose complete snapshot compares equal; no pruning.
node_accounting.limit_rule: After a successful commit, if explored_node_count equals node_limit, stop before visiting its successor; record NODE_LIMIT and make no objective claim for that successor.

objective.extractor: Only the resource amount belonging to the supplied SandboxResourceContract.
kinds: RESOURCE_AT_HORIZON: MAXIMIZE or MINIMIZE at exact max_depth
REACH_RESOURCE_COMPARISON: LT, LE, EQ, GE or GT against a finite explicit Decimal; first satisfying prefix, including root
MIN_STEPS_TO_RESOURCE_COMPARISON: same predicate, minimizing committed steps to first satisfaction
objective.deferred_kind: LEXICOGRAPHIC_RESOURCE_METRICS is deferred from v1; no generic metric language is implied.
objective.identity: SHA-256 of canonical-v2 objective document; included in plan/result identity
objective.satisfaction: A satisfied predicate terminates that branch locally; it does not assert a game terminal.

ranking.when: After complete exploration or an explicit limit stop, before max_plans truncation.
ranking.horizon: Declared resource comparison, then lexicographic source-action ordinal path.
ranking.reach: Shorter satisfying path, then lexicographic source-action ordinal path.
ranking.min_steps: Committed action count, then lexicographic source-action ordinal path.
ranking.tie_policy: LOCAL_PLANNER_POLICY; action_id string lexical order is not used.

completeness.complete: All supported branches explored under the objective/horizon rules, with no blocked decision context or node limit.
completeness.found: At least one candidate exists; search_complete may be false and an incomplete result is BEST_OBSERVED only.
completeness.no_plan_within_horizon: No candidate exists and search_complete is true.
completeness.blocked: No candidate exists, a reachable decision context was blocked, and no node limit occurred.
completeness.limit_reached: No candidate exists and node_limit prevented a successor visit; takes precedence over BLOCKED.
completeness.unsupported: The request/objective resource cannot be represented by SANDBOX_RESOURCE_V1; no action exclusion is fabricated.

state_accounting.key: scenario identity + resource contract identity + objective identity + search policy identity + remaining horizon + semantic_hash_v2 of complete TerraSnapshotV2
state_accounting.collision_check: Complete snapshot equality is required after a hash match.

result.prefix_replay: Restores initial snapshot and independently reconstructs every legal view, plan, commit, hash, revision, RNG, objective value and termination.
result.canonical_identity: SHA-256 of canonical-v2 document excluding only its own identity field; no timestamps, durations, usernames or paths.

training_boundary: Planner results and caller-declared objective values are not rewards, advantages, Q targets, value targets, policy probabilities, native-optimal labels, independent oracles or automatic M8 datasets.
